title: 第25章 西岭山脉第26章 你这人皇幡怎么冒黑烟啊
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
西岭山脉横亘在大陆中北部，绵延三千余里，主峰如剑，直插云霄。
以其高而险的地势成为人类王国与精灵王国之间的天然屏障。
深谷、暗河、溶洞、绝壁、冰瀑、密林，同一座山上可以同时见到热带藤蔓与寒带苔藓，南坡的阔叶林与北坡的针叶林被一道山脊隔开，老死不相往来。
大自然用了上百万年在这里刻下秩序，壮丽、复杂、自洽。
但三百年前，魔族的一支奇袭分队翻越了这道天堑。
他们带来的不止是军队，更有一套完整的魔界生态：狗头人、兽人、腐木蜘蛛、岩行蛛等生物的后代。
它们是魔族军队的炮灰、斥候、后勤工具，甚至是“生态武器”。
魔族打的是这样的算盘：将魔物散布在山脉之中，让它们在人类的腹地生根发芽，繁殖扩散。
这样一来，即便正面战场失利，这些魔物也会像钉子一样楔入人类王国的后方，成为永久的祸患。
那一战，当年的王国军队在山脉东侧成功阻击了这支魔族分队，将其全歼。
可他们没能阻止那些被带来的魔物在战斗中四散奔逃，钻进西岭山脉的深谷密林之中。
这些魔物是入侵物种，在这片没有天敌的土地上疯狂繁衍了三百年，取代了山脉中低层的生态位。
人类和精灵也不是没有尝试过清剿。
只是这些魔物钻进了士兵进不去的溶洞、爬不上的绝壁、找不见的暗河。
清剿的成本太高，收益太低，渐渐地，就没人管了。
反正它们也出不了山。
季天站在山脚下，仰头看着那道横亘在天际的黑色轮廓。
他没有在看风景。
神识像一张无形的网，从眉心铺开，贴着山体向上蔓延。
山势走向、灵气分布、魔物聚集区域——这些信息在识海中逐渐清晰，像一张被点亮的地图。

“灵脉。”他在心里如此想道。
前世在网文里，但凡名山大川，必有灵脉。
灵脉汇聚之处，或生天材地宝，或成洞天福地，或盘踞一方妖王。
这片山脉的“势”很足，山脊如龙脊起伏，河谷如脉络交错，是典型的“藏风聚气”之局。
他偏头看了一眼身后的莉莉丝。
银白色的长发从兜帽边缘露出来，她正蹲在地上，用一根树枝戳一只路过的甲虫。
甲虫翻了个身，六条腿在空中乱蹬，她戳得更欢了。
“走。”
莉莉丝扔掉树枝，拍拍手站起来，小跑着跟上去。
“师父，这座山好大啊。我们要进去多久？”
“看情况。”
“里面魔物多吗？”
“多。”
“那我们能不能绕开那些特别丑的？比如黏糊糊的那种？我不是怕，我就是觉得它们长得影响心情。你想啊，万一我以后回忆起来，别人问我‘你修行路上最难忘的是什么’，我说‘一只黏糊糊的蜘蛛’，多丢人。”
“不能。”
“……哦。那至少让我提前做一下心理建设，比如你喊一声‘丑的来了’，我就闭上眼睛。”
季天没有理会，迈步走进山林，脚下没有路，只有碎石和落叶，步伐不紧不慢，每一步都踩得极稳。
莉莉丝跟在他身后，深一脚浅一脚地踩着碎石，斗篷被树枝挂了好几次，每挂一次就发出一声心疼的“哎呀”——不是心疼自己，是心疼斗篷。
“师父，你这件斗篷多少钱买的？”
“不知道，别人送的。”
content_en:
The Xiling Mountains stretch across the central and northern parts of the mainland for more than 3,000 miles. The main peak is like a sword, reaching into the sky.
With its high and dangerous terrain, it has become a natural barrier between the human kingdom and the elven kingdom.
Deep valleys, underground rivers, caves, cliffs, ice waterfalls, dense forests, tropical vines and frigid mosses can be seen on the same mountain. The broad-leaved forest on the south slope and the coniferous forest on the north slope are separated by a ridge, and they have never been able to communicate with each other.
Nature has spent millions of years carving order here, which is magnificent, complex and self-consistent.
But three hundred years ago, a surprise attack team of the demon clan crossed this natural chasm.
They brought not only an army, but also a complete set of demonic ecology: the descendants of kobolds, orcs, rotten wood spiders, rock crawling spiders and other creatures.
They are cannon fodder, scouts, logistical tools, and even "ecological weapons" for the demon army.
The demon clan's plan is to spread the monsters in the mountains and let them take root in the hinterland of mankind, multiply and spread.
In this way, even if the frontal battlefield is defeated, these monsters will be wedged like nails into the rear of the human kingdom and become a permanent scourge.
In that battle, the kingdom's army successfully blocked the demon detachment on the east side of the mountain range and wiped it out.
But they were unable to stop the monsters that were brought from fleeing in all directions during the battle and burrowing into the deep valleys and dense forests of the Xiling Mountains.
These monsters are invasive species that have thrived in this land without natural predators for three hundred years, replacing the ecological niches in the lower and middle levels of the mountains.
It's not like humans and elves have never tried to eliminate them.
It's just that these monsters got into caves that soldiers couldn't enter, cliffs that couldn't be climbed, and underground rivers that couldn't be found.
The cost of eradication was too high and the benefits were too low. Gradually, no one took care of it.
They can't get out of the mountain anyway.
Ji Tian stood at the foot of the mountain, looking up at the black outline stretching across the sky.
He wasn't looking at the scenery.
Divine consciousness is like an invisible net, spreading from the center of the eyebrows and spreading upwards against the mountain.
The direction of the mountain, the distribution of spiritual energy, and the areas where monsters gather—these information gradually became clear in the sea of ​​consciousness, like a lighted map.
"Spiritual pulse." He thought in his heart.
In the past life, in online articles, every famous mountain and river must have spiritual veins.
Where spiritual veins gather, treasures from heaven and earth may be born, or a blessed land of caves and heavens may be formed, or a demon king may be entrenched.
The "power" of this mountain range is very strong. The ridges rise and fall like a dragon's spine, and the valleys intersect like veins. It is a typical situation of "hiding wind and gathering energy".
He turned his head and glanced at Lilith behind him.
Her long silver hair was exposed from the edge of her hood. She was squatting on the ground, poking a passing beetle with a branch.
The beetle turned over and kicked its six legs in the air, and she poked even more happily.
"Let's go."
Lilith threw away the branch, clapped her hands, stood up, and trotted to follow.
"Master, this mountain is so big. How long will it take us to go in?"
"It depends."
"Are there many monsters in there?"
"Much."
"Then can we avoid those that are particularly ugly? For example, the slimy ones? I'm not afraid, I just think their appearance affects my mood. Think about it, if I think about it later and someone asks me, 'What is the most unforgettable thing about your spiritual practice,' and I say, 'A slimy spider,' how embarrassing it would be."
"Can't."
"...Oh. Then at least let me do some mental preparation in advance. For example, if you shout 'The ugly one is coming', I will close my eyes."
Ji Tian ignored it and walked into the mountain forest. There was no road under his feet, only gravel and fallen leaves. His steps were unhurried and slow, and each step was very steady.
Lilith followed behind him, stepping on the gravel one step at a time. Her cloak got caught on a branch several times, and every time it got hung up, she let out a distressed "Oops"—not feeling sorry for herself, but feeling sorry for the cloak.
"Master, how much did you pay for this cloak?"
"I don't know, someone else gave it to me."
